meal.title: Write a custom __init__ method
meal.objective: Define an __init__ that receives a name and stores it on the object

voice.script: What if you could give every student a name the moment they’re created? How do you store a name inside each new object? self is like saying “myself”. Here’s the code that defines the class. The __init__ method takes two parameters: self and a name supplied when we create the object. Inside it we assign the name to an attribute on self, so each instance remembers its own name. Finally we create a Student called Alice and print her stored name. Running this prints Alice, showing that the name was saved on that particular object. The __init__ method lets you set up each instance when it’s made. Create a Book class that stores title and author using __init__.
